name: Spring Framework
description: Spring Framework provides a comprehensive programming and configuration model for modern Java-based enterprise applications. It focuses on the plumbing of enterprise applications so that teams can focus on application-level business logic, without unnecessary ties to specific deployment environments.

scope.comment: Approved for use across the entire organization

capabilities.capability: Dependency Injection - Core IoC container for managing application components and their dependencies
Aspect-Oriented Programming (AOP) - Cross-cutting concerns like logging, security, and transactions
Data Access - Comprehensive support for JDBC, ORM (JPA, Hibernate), transactions, and DAO patterns
Spring MVC - Model-View-Controller framework for building web applications and RESTful APIs
Spring WebFlux - Reactive programming support for non-blocking web applications
Security - Authentication, authorization, and security features through Spring Security integration
Testing - Comprehensive testing support with mock objects, TestContext framework, and Spring MVC Test
Integration - Support for JMS, JCA, JMX, email, tasks, scheduling, and caching
Observability - Built-in support for monitoring, logging, and application observability

use-cases: Web application development using Spring MVC
Data access layer implementation with ORM
Reactive web applications with Spring WebFlux

versions.description: Latest major version with Java 17+ baseline and Jakarta EE 10 support
Previous major version with Java 8+ baseline

vendor.comment: Developed and maintained by VMware Tanzu (formerly Pivotal)

links.comment: Originally developed by Rod Johnson, now maintained by VMware Tanzu
